primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: PPS included all FAS participants (all randomized participants who received at least 1 injection of study drug and who had at least 1 post-Baseline efficacy or exploratory measurements) who received at least 5 of the 7 doses of the study drug, did not receive antihypertensive medications during the Treatment Period and prior to Day 43, and had no significant protocol deviations that would have been expected to affect efficacy or exploratory assessments.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Percent Change From Baseline in Plasma Angiotensinogen (AGT) at Day 43 (Week 7) Compared to Placebo
